$comment: Single declaration of the substitution tokens used by BOTH start paths. tools/repo.mjs init reads it directly; .template.config/template.json mirrors it for `dotnet new`. tools/tests/rename-manifest.test.mjs fails if the two drift apart, so neither path can diverge. Renaming is targeted: substitutions apply only to files matched by the globs below, never repository-wide. The team-maintained files under .claude/ are included in contentGlobs because they point at concrete repository paths; a generated application needs those pointers to resolve. docs/adr/** and openspec/** stay excluded: they are records, not living instructions, so ADRs refer to the architecture profile by a path relative to the test project rather than by its full name.

tokens.name: solutionName
tokens.description: Solution name and project-name prefix. Applies to file and directory names as well as file contents.

tokens.name: rootNamespace
tokens.description: Root namespace. Shares the placeholder text with solutionName, so both are driven by template.json's sourceName on the dotnet new path. Making the two configured values differ requires an explicit <RootNamespace>; the config check fails otherwise.
